featureFlags._doc: Runtime feature flags read at Electron startup. Do NOT rely on these for security-critical defaults — a stale version.json on an offline client stays at the shipped values. Security-critical changes must land as code pushes with a version bump.

notes: v1.28.1: Connect Microsoft Clarity + PostHog from the Connections panel, a brand-switcher click fix, and an app-wide reliability/speed/UX hardening pass. Anchor: 2026-06-22. CONNECTION TILES: Microsoft Clarity (free behavioral analytics: heatmaps, session recordings, rage/dead clicks, scroll depth) and PostHog (product analytics: funnels, retention, events) now have Connections tiles. Both connectors shipped backend-only in v1.25.0; this adds the masked paste-token tiles so a brand can connect them from the panel instead of via the agent. Clarity is a single Data Export API token; PostHog uses a 3-step modal (Personal API Key + numeric Project ID + optional host, with numeric-id validation). Each token is vaulted brand-scoped and validated on the first insights pull; the load-bearing fix was adding the keys to CONFIG_FIELD_ALLOWLIST so the tile save cannot silently fail (the postscript-save-broken incident class). Locked by magic-tiles.test.js. TRIPLE WHALE shopDomain: the binary now handles the no-Shopify-connected case standalone. triplewhale-verify-key applies and PERSISTS an explicit shopDomain override so a brand with no Shopify stays scoped on future scheduled pulls, and a 403 is reported with shop-aware guidance that no longer echoes Triple Whale's response body into the user-facing error (Rule 6). The MCP triplewhale tool accepts shopDomain (forwarded to the binary). Locked by triplewhale_shopdomain_test.go (5) + mcp tool tests. APP RELIABILITY / SPEED / UX (RSI pass, 4-agent audit): fixed the reported brand-switcher bug where clicking a brand also opened the Revenue (stats) window behind the takeover. Root cause: the brand-switcher button is a child of the perf bar, whose click handler opens Revenue, and the button did not stop propagation. Centralized overlay sibling-hiding into one closeOtherOverlays() helper so opening one surface can never leave another stacked behind it (brand switcher / Wisdom / Palantir / Agency / Revenue), replacing five drifted hand-maintained lists. Guarded 6 missed async paths against stuck spinners, unhandled rejections, and brand-switch races (live-ads load, spellbook race, double-send, plus three IPC handlers that could reject the renderer on a malformed brand or a relay outage). Added a 1.5s, brands-dir-mtime-keyed memo to get-brands (called from ~14 sites on every brand switch, previously a synchronous N-file read + MD5 each time). Routed 5 raw backend error strings through friendlyError, and gave the universal modal proper dialog / aria-modal semantics. 14 new source-scan regression guards; full app JS suite green (1283 pass / 0 fail). NO BREAKING CHANGES. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.28.0. PRIOR RELEASE v1.28.0: Palantir reimagined as a brand-tailored winning-ad-ideas wall + a redesigned 1-click brand switcher. Anchor: 2026-06-20. PALANTIR: the Palantir tab is no longer just a competitor-ad spy — it now AUTO-LOADS a full-window, sci-fi 'portal' wall of the top-performing ads in your brand's niche with ZERO typing, sourced from TrendTrack's ad-discovery API (POST /v1/ads/query, ranked by reach/spend — Meta-sourced — and tailored to your brand-manifest Category). Each ad is distilled into an actionable idea card (hook, format, why-it's-winning, advertiser) with a one-click 'Generate for my brand' that hands the winning angle to the creative engine for a fresh ON-BRAND riff (explicitly never a copy). New Go: trendtrackDiscoverAds (trendtrack.go, verified /v1/ads/query schema) + palantir_ideas.go aggregator/distiller + the palantir-ideas action + a main.js IPC; read-only by construction, every call routes through PreflightCheck + Record (api.trendtrack.io is in the hook blocklist), credit-frugal (1 credit/row, capped at 30), friendly errors (Rule 6). Graceful connect-CTA when no ad-intel platform is connected (never a dead wall). The Palantir toolbar button moved one slot RIGHT of Reports; tooltip is now exactly 'Palantir'; the named-competitor Foreplay spy is preserved as a secondary collapsed section. BRAND SWITCHER: the brand dropdown is replaced by a button that opens a FULL-WINDOW tile takeover — every brand a tile, plus a '+ New Brand' tile. Selecting a tile swaps brand in ONE click, instantly (the overlay closes immediately + the proven optimistic-preseed swap fires). '+ New Brand' opens a minimal Name + Website form whose Add activates the brand IMMEDIATELY and runs all ingestion (scrape, brand guide, products, competitors) in the background — zero friction, zero wait, zero mid-flow questions (honors the Brand Onboarding Zero-Friction rule). The hidden <select id=brand-select> is kept as the value-source so every existing brand-aware path (~25 call sites) + the proven swap logic stay untouched (no regression). Tests: palantir_ideas_test.go + 13 new renderer guards (Palantir auto-load / generate-bridge / full-takeover / button-position / tooltip / connect-CTA + brand-switcher button-not-dropdown / 1-click tile swap / new-brand instant+async / label-sync). Independently re-verified 10/10 on BOTH features with no Critical/High issues; full Go suite green (248s); full app JS suite green; build/vet/gofmt clean. NO BREAKING CHANGES — Palantir's competitor spy still works; the brand-swap logic is reused, not rewritten. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.27.0. ALSO IN v1.28.0: META AD-SET INSIGHTS: meta.go insights now pull campaign + ad-set + ad granularity in a single call, so reporting and optimization can act on ad-set-level performance (audiences, placements), surfaced to the agent through the meta insights path (tests in meta_test.go). RELIABILITY FIX (brand-scoped vault): fixed the Go binary's two-pass vault resolution. loadConfig's first '_global' pass collapsed every brand-scoped @@VAULT placeholder to '' before applyBrandVault could resolve it, so brand tokens (metaAccessToken, triplewhaleApiKey, etc.) stayed empty when the binary ran standalone. applyBrandVault now re-derives the original placeholders from an immutable pre-strip config snapshot and resolves them per-brand, with the cross-brand-leak guard intact. Production was never affected (the Electron app pre-resolves placeholders in Node before invoking the binary); this makes the binary correct on its own, defense in depth (vault_brand_pass_test.go). PRIOR RELEASE v1.27.0: OpenAI / ChatGPT Ads connector — Merlin can now run and manage paid ads inside ChatGPT. Anchor: 2026-06-19. NEW PAID-ADS PLATFORM: OpenAI Ads (api.ads.openai.com, US self-serve beta). Brand-specific BYOK: each brand mints an Ads API key at ads.openai.com and pastes it into a masked Connections tile (never in chat — it authorizes real spend). Full ad hierarchy: account → campaign → ad group → upload → ad → insights, all via openai_ads.go (Bearer auth; every call routes through PreflightCheck + RecordSuccess on a dedicated openai_ads rate-limit bucket). mcp__merlin__openai_ads actions: account/campaigns/insights (read), push (LAUNCH a live ad: builds the campaign + ad group, uploads the creative, creates the ad), pause. SPEND SAFETY (this connector spends real money, so it wires into every money rail like Meta/TikTok/Google): the push path is gated by FIVE layers — requireApproval (the Electron approval card sets cmd.Approved; the binary refuses to spend without it), validateDailyBudget on the FINAL micros→dollars value (daily cap + the $5000 cents-as-dollars hard ceiling), enforceMonthlyCap (straight-line monthly projection + the master pause-all flag), enforceAggregateMonthlyCap (cross-platform: sums active daily spend across every OTHER connected platform so OpenAI can't stack past the brand's MaxMonthlyAdSpend — like every other push path, CI-guarded), and recordActiveSpend after the create so the aggregate spend-anomaly guard sees the commitment. A mid-chain failure best-effort pauses the half-built campaign so it can never serve. OpenAI budgets are LIFETIME in micros (1,000,000 = $1); the campaign lifetime = dailyBudget × 30 and is validated against both maxDailyAdBudget (implied daily) and maxMonthlyAdSpend. The 'push' action also routes through the host SPEND_ACTIONS approval card with the cents-detector + budget context (Rule 19). api.ads.openai.com is in the hook blocklist so nothing bypasses the preflight or the spend rails. Errors are friendly (Rule 6) — no raw Go/HTTP/body/stack leaks. Brand-scoped vault (openaiAdsApiKey, openaiAdsAccountId) with disconnect coverage. Tests: openai_ads_test.go pins the 4-call create chain, the lifetime-budget micros math, Bearer auth, friendly errors with no body leak, the five-safety-layer source-scan (incl. the cross-platform aggregate cap + the orphan-campaign pause), the insights aggregation, the rate-limit + brand-scope registration; JS parity + persist + approval suites green. Hardened to 10/10 by a four-lens adversarial RSI pass (spend-safety, credential-security, reliability, UX). Full Go suite green; build/vet/gofmt clean. NO BREAKING CHANGES — opt-in, additive; no OAuth/worker changes (API-key auth). REGISTRATION: needs an OpenAI Ads API key from ads.openai.com (US beta, no minimum spend); works the moment it is pasted. MAGIC-PANEL TILES: added Triple Whale + OpenAI Ads tiles to the Brand Specific section (masked API-key paste, connection dot, disconnect), and fixed a tile-visibility bug where universal-scope tiles (Foreplay competitor-ad spying + TrendTrack ecommerce intelligence) silently disappeared on every recognized vertical and only showed when the brand's vertical was unknown. Root cause: the vertical filter hid every tile not in the active vertical's integrations list, including universal tiles that only survived by being duplicated into the creative-tools spread; Foreplay/TrendTrack were never in that spread. The filter now never hides data-scope=universal tiles, and the same-class gap that hid Mailchimp on every recognized vertical is fixed too (added alongside Klaviyo). Locked by app/magic-tiles.test.js (7 tests). NEW CONNECTOR: Rokt network reporting (api.rokt.com), READ-ONLY. Rokt's ad network has a real API but campaign management is dashboard-only (no write API), so this connector reports on Rokt campaign performance (impressions, referrals, spend via the Query API) and cannot launch or manage Rokt ads — that distinction is enforced by construction (rokt.go ships no write verbs; TestRoktSourceHasNoWriteVerbs). BYOK + brand-scoped: the brand provisions its OWN App ID + App Secret + Account ID at my.rokt.com (these are the brand's credentials, not Merlin's OAuth client, so Rule 2 doesn't apply — vaulted brand-scoped like any API key); rokt.go exchanges them for a 1h Bearer token (OAuth2 client_credentials, Basic auth) and reads the Query API, every call through PreflightCheck + RecordSuccess on a dedicated rokt rate-limit bucket. Connect is a 3-field tile modal (App ID / App Secret / Account ID); mcp__merlin__rokt actions report/status/connect/verify (read-only, no approval card). api.rokt.com is in the hook blocklist. Friendly errors (Rule 6), number-or-string metric coercion. Tests: rokt_test.go (Basic-auth token exchange, Bearer query, 2-row aggregation with string-metric coercion, friendly-no-leak, read-only source-scan, rate-limit + brand-scope). Requires an active Rokt advertiser account (enterprise-onboarded). Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.26.0. PRIOR RELEASE v1.26.0: Triple Whale analytics connector + connector-hardening RSI pass. Anchor: 2026-06-19. NEW CONNECTOR: Triple Whale (brand-specific) end-to-end. Pulls the topline a CMO steers on that platform ROAS alone cannot show: New-Customer ROAS (newCustomersRoas), New-Customer CPA (newCustomersCpa), MER, blended + attributed ROAS, Net Margin, Ad Spend, Blended Sales, Net Profit, new-customer revenue/orders, plus Triple Whale's peer benchmarks. The Summary Page pull (POST api.triplewhale.com/api/v2/summary-page/get-data) routes through PreflightCheck + RecordSuccess (Rule 4) with a dedicated triplewhale rate-limit bucket; metric values are coerced number-or-string so a single string-typed metric can never poison the whole pull (US-grouped thousands parse, ambiguous EU decimals are skipped rather than misread). Two brand-specific credential paths, both Authorization: Bearer: OAuth2 (full Rule 17 wiring — Config OAuthTripleWhale, getTripleWhaleOAuth factory, bootstrapProviderKeys, oauth_exchange dispatch, autorefresh, brandScopedKeys, worker getOAuthCreds/getOAuthClientIDs) and a personal API key (app.triplewhale.com/api-keys) that works the moment it is pasted. api.triplewhale.com is in the hook blocklist so nothing bypasses the preflight. New MCP tool mcp__merlin__triplewhale (summary/status/connect/verify) + platform_login entry + connection-status + disconnect, all brand-scoped, tokens redacted and vault-only (never plaintext, never surfaced to the renderer). OAuth go-live needs the TRIPLEWHALE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET Cloudflare secrets + a registered TW app; the personal-API-key path is usable immediately. SHOPIFY LEGACY-TOKEN MIGRATION HARDENING (irreversible-op reliability): the /api/oauth/shopify-migrate endpoint is now recovery-first and idempotent. On a successful exchange the new token is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM, AAD=shop) keyed by the authenticated machineId for 24h (new migrate_recovery D1 table, cron-pruned), so a retry after a lost response returns the stored token instead of re-exchanging a now-revoked one (closes the crash-before-persist brick). Per-license rate limit on top of per-IP; the cron persist retries the shop_installs UPDATE; the D1 sync requires MERLIN_DASH_KEY so a keyless-but-DB-present deploy cannot burn the exchange. WORKER HARDENING: getOrdersLast30Days now paginates via the Shopify Link header (bounded, partial-on-error) so a store with more than 250 orders in 30 days stops under-reporting revenue; the compliance webhook logs a warning when a delete-topic arrives with no resolvable shop; getDecryptedToken was unexported (it bypassed the refresh choke-point). TRIPLE WHALE ERROR UX: every error path is friendly (Rule 6) — no raw Go transport strings, HTTP response bodies, JSON, or stack traces reach the user; raw detail goes to stderr only. UI FIXES: batch-image thumbnails now render reliably (eager load + bounded backoff + a teardown guard that stops retries on a detached card); the right-click context menu is no longer hidden behind the full-screen lightbox. RSI: independently re-scored to 10/10 across credential security, irreversible-op integrity, parser robustness, error UX, and test + performance, each fix locked by a regression test. Full Go suite green (247s); all landing + app JS suites green; build, vet, and gofmt clean. NO BREAKING CHANGES — Triple Whale is opt-in and additive; all hardening is backward-compatible. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.25.1. PRIOR RELEASE v1.25.1: Bug-fix release, three Meta binary fixes. Anchor: 2026-06-14. (1) FULL-RESOLUTION AD CREATIVES (#205): fetchMetaAdCreativeURLs now fetches ad-creative thumbnails at 1080px by sizing thumbnail_url on the AdCreative node directly. image_url is empty for post-based creatives (video and most statics), Meta ignores thumbnail_width/height on a nested creative{thumbnail_url} expansion, and an ad-account token cannot read the post's full_picture (needs pages_read_engagement, returns (#10)); the creative-node-direct fetch is the only path that returns presentation resolution. Fixes 64x64 thumbnails in the Archive grid and the weekly creative-showcase reports. Tests: TestMetaCreativeFetchPath + TestMetaCreativeSizedThumbPath. (2) CASE-INSENSITIVE BRAND LOOKUP (#204): brand resolution no longer returns an empty $0 'no platforms connected' dashboard when the requested brand name casing differs from the stored slug (for example APOTHEKE vs apotheke). (3) HONEST DISCOVER BINDING (#206): runMetaDiscover (the discover action, twin of the already-hardened runMetaLogin) now reports whether each ad account, page, and pixel was a real brandMatches hit, only claims 'matched brand X' when true, WARNs loudly on a fallback, and exposes adAccountMatched/pageMatched/pixelMatched in its JSON. Previously it silently bound the first active account and first page, and even printed '(matched brand X)' for a pure fallback; a brand was bound to an unrelated account and page and a full weekly report was generated on the wrong brand's data before a human noticed. Auto-pick is preserved (no mid-setup prompt), so zero-friction onboarding is unchanged. Tests: TestMetaPickByBrand + TestDiscover_HonestFallback. Full Go suite green (245s). NO BREAKING CHANGES: all three are bug fixes, binary-only (no app files or skills changed), so existing installs receive them through the normal binary auto-update. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.25.0. PRIOR RELEASE v1.25.0: Agency-grade reliability + two new analytics connectors + competitor ad intelligence + zero-friction onboarding. Anchor: 2026-05-22. NEW CONNECTORS: (1) Microsoft Clarity — brand-scoped behavioral-analytics connector (Data Export API token via clarityPersistToken → vault key clarityApiToken; rate-limit bucket clarity@www.clarity.ms; surfaced in MCP + connection layer + DisconnectPlatform). (2) PostHog — brand-scoped ecommerce-analytics connector (two-phase query plan: phase-A event breakdown is fatal, phase-B revenue/top-pages/top-products degrade to Warnings; vault keys posthogApiKey/posthogProjectId/posthogHost; rate-limit bucket posthog). PALANTIR COMPETITOR AD WALL: new palantir-feed action (Foreplay ad-feed + thumbnail cache, SSRF-guarded media download) + a dedicated infinite-scroll competitor-ad tab in the renderer (IntersectionObserver with full teardown on panel close, 300-card cap, friendlyError-wrapped errors). META EMQ FIX: meta_audit now uses the real Meta Dataset Quality API (event match quality) instead of the prior stale heuristic; agentName threaded through the MCP tool. SIX RSI HARDENING LOOPS: (#1 money safety) master pause-all-spend / resume-all-spend kill switch (resume is cmd.Approved-gated per Rule 18; pause overrides cmd.Force), delta-based spend-anomaly guard (3× aggregate jump OR +$50/day single-action, runs independent of MaxMonthlyAdSpend so cap-free users are protected; never fires on initial setup), and cap-fire Slack notifications on every BLOCK/FORCE/PAUSE/RESUME. (#2 decision explainability) new decision-why action surfaces the signed-DecisionFact diary in plain English, filterable by adId, newest-first, default 90-day window. (#5 failure recovery) the autorefresh dead-circuit (3-consecutive-refresh-failure breaker) now overlays onto the watchdog report — a platform with creds in vault but a tripped refresh circuit reports 'invalid: reconnect needed' instead of a false 'ok'. (#10 schema-churn anti-fragility) MissingFieldError standard for platform-response required-field checks + a source-scan banning DisallowUnknownFields() in production (lenient decode survives platforms adding fields). (#11 API spend transparency) new api-spend-summary action + per-brand .merlin-api-spend.jsonl ledger (Today/Month/AllTime + per-vendor; RecordAPISpend primitive, caller-computed cost, best-effort append never blocks generation). (#12 accessibility) a11y source-scan over the renderer (every button has an accessible name, every text input has aria-label/label, ≥2 aria-live regions) + aria-labels added to 6 previously-unlabeled inputs. WHOLE-APP RSI HARDENING: foreplayDownloadFile SSRF guard (rejects loopback/private/link-local + non-http(s), per-hop CheckRedirect re-validation, 10-hop cap); rateLimitedDo refuses to retry a non-rewindable body + adds 0-20% jitter to the 429 backoff (thundering-herd guard); lastSaveNano → atomic.Int64; .vault.bak backup write made atomic (tmp+rename); timingSafeEqualStr fails closed on empty/non-string input across all 3 landing copies (the old String(a||'') coercion made ('','') compare equal — an auth-bypass class); AbortSignal.timeout(20s) on the Shopify token-migration + Stripe-transfer Worker fetches. DROPDOWN-FIRST ONBOARDING: brand_activate is now the FIRST onboarding action (before the scrape), passing {brand, displayName, url} so the host creates the brand folder + switches to it immediately — if the scrape or any later step fails, the brand is already saved + switchable and setup resumes instead of redoing everything (new app/brand-scaffold.js scaffoldBrandStub, idempotent, never clobbers an existing brand). Zero-approval onboarding audited + locked (every setup-flow tool resolves to a non-spend, non-carded action; exhaustive enumeration test fails CI if a future change would card mid-setup). ONBOARDING UX: live turn timer now renders h/m/s (formatElapsed: 160 → '2m 40s') instead of raw seconds; the spinner verb no longer vanishes at the 2-minute mark on long turns (setStatusLabel cancels the 120s stuck-clear once a real progress verb appears); brand_scrape/activate/guide/bulk_upload get real progress verbs instead of generic 'Channeling'. TEST COVERAGE: full Go suite green (245s), autoCMO app 1328/1328, landing 445/445, wisdom-api 71/71, skill validator + updatable-coverage pass. NO BREAKING CHANGES — all new connectors are opt-in, all new actions are additive, legacy onboarding still works (the dropdown-first path degrades to the old behavior when displayName/url are absent). Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty) — this release ships SHA-integrity + HTTPS, identical trust level to v1.24.0. PRIOR RELEASE v1.24.0: Shopify expiring offline tokens — full migration. Anchor: 2026-05-18. SHOPIFY DEPRECATED PERMANENT OFFLINE TOKENS on 2026-05-18 and shipped a Partner Dashboard warning: 'Deprecated offline token use detected in last 30 days.' The new model issues a short-lived access token (~24h) + a long-lived refresh token (~90d). Apps that ignore expires_in 401 on every API call once Shopify enforces the change. This release migrates BOTH the Cloudflare Worker (web dashboard at merlingotme.com/dash) AND the Go desktop binary end-to-end. WORKER LAYER: (a) D1 shop_installs + dash_handoffs gain access_token_expires_at + encrypted_refresh_token + refresh_token_expires_at columns. Idempotent ALTER migration runs at boot per isolate via ensureShopifyTokenColumns. (b) OAuth callback (handleAuthWebCallback) captures expires_in + refresh_token + refresh_token_expires_in via extractShopifyTokenLifetime; upsertShopInstall + mintShopifyHandoff persist all three. (c) shopifyAdminFetchWithRefresh wraps the existing 403-retry helper with proactive refresh (ensureFreshShopifyToken checks expires_at + REFRESH_LEEWAY_S=60s) plus reactive 401-retry-after-force-refresh. (d) softDeleteShop wipes ALL token columns including the new refresh token + expiries on uninstall webhooks. (e) BFF /api/oauth/exchange Shopify branch no longer hardcodes `expires_in: 0` — passes through real Shopify-returned expires_in + refresh_token. (f) BFF /api/oauth/refresh removes Shopify from the no_refresh denylist and adds a dedicated branch that POSTs grant_type=refresh_token to Shopify's per-shop refresh endpoint. (g) NEW one-time legacy-token migration cron (wrangler.toml triggers: cron '0 4 * * *'). worker.js scheduled() handler invokes runShopifyLegacyTokenMigration from the new shopify-token-migration.js module — walks shop_installs WHERE access_token_expires_at = 0 in batches of 100, calls Shopify's Token Exchange API (grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange + subject_token + subject_token_type + expiring=1) per the docs. Shopify revokes the legacy token server-side on success — the exchange is IRREVERSIBLE. Failed shops stay at expires_at=0 so the next tick retries; failures don't block other shops in the same tick. GO BINARY LAYER: (h) Config gains ShopifyRefreshToken + ShopifyAccessTokenExpiresAt + ShopifyRefreshTokenExpiresAt. (i) vault.go brandScopedKeys allowlist gains shopifyRefreshToken. (j) shopify.go's REST helper shopifyRequestWithStatus + GraphQL helper shopifyGraphQL both refactored — proactive refresh on near-expiry + reactive force-refresh + retry once on 401. Bounded to one retry to prevent loops on revoked refresh tokens. (k) autorefresh.go's refreshable spec gains an Extra func(cfg) hook that resolves per-provider payload fields at refresh time; Shopify uses it to pass {shop: <slug>} to bffRefresh. bffRefresh signature changed to accept extra map[string]string (existing callers pass nil — backward-compatible). (l) shopify_handoff.go's shopifyHandoffResponse struct gains AccessTokenExpiresAt + RefreshToken + RefreshTokenExpiresAt; runShopifyHandoff vaults the refresh token, writes both expiries to the config file. BFF /api/handoff/<code> response carries the same three fields. TESTS: 22 new JS landing tests (shopify-token-exchange.test.mjs — extractShopifyTokenLifetime, upsertShopInstall round-trip, softDeleteShop wipes ALL columns, handoff round-trip including legacy mint with no tokenMeta, ensureFreshShopifyToken fresh/legacy/expired/near-expiry/revoked/soft-deleted, shopifyAdminFetchWithRefresh 401-retry, runShopifyLegacyTokenMigration happy path + failure-isolation + missing-env-no-op, ensureShopifyTokenColumns idempotency, source-scan regression guards on worker.js + softDeleteShop). 9 new Go tests (shopify_token_refresh_test.go — Config field shape, vault allowlist, refreshable spec, Extra hook, handoff response shape, source-scan that shopify.go's REST + GraphQL both call MaybeRenewPlatformToken). Full JS suite 442/442 green serially (parallel runs hit a pre-existing race in shim setup unrelated to this change). Full Go suite green (241s). NO BREAKING CHANGES — legacy permanent tokens (access_token_expires_at=0) continue to work; the one-time migration cron converts them gradually. The new fields are all opt-in / default-zero. PRIOR RELEASE v1.23.2: Critical fix — non-fal-namespace edit models (openai/gpt-image-2/edit, black-forest-labs/.../edit, etc.) were silently downgraded to their text-to-image variants. Live incident anchor: 2026-05-15. ROOT CAUSE: isFalEditModel (the upstream decision point that routes edit-vs-text-to-image) only detected the /edit segment on slugs starting with 'fal-ai/'. Any other namespace fell through to the legacy bare-alias `-edit` suffix check, which returns false for path-suffixed `/edit` slugs (the slug ends with `/edit`, not `-edit`). Result: isEditModel=false → router sent the call to falGenerateImage (text-to-image) → which called resolveFalImageSlug(slug, editMode=false) → which CORRECTLY strips `/edit` for text-to-image safety → silent downgrade. The agent passed `imageModel: 'openai/gpt-image-2/edit'`, the binary used `openai/gpt-image-2` (blind text-to-image) and pasted the reference flat-lay on top via composite. Model never saw the reference → wrong-looking creatives despite 'PIXEL-PERFECT' lock language in the prompt. This was the parallel fix that got missed on 2026-04-29 when resolveFalImageSlug + stripFalEditSuffix were updated for namespace passthrough — those two helpers became namespace-agnostic, but isFalEditModel stayed fal-ai/-only. CONTRACT VIOLATION: caller-supplied model strings are the caller's intent. The binary NEVER silently rewrites or downgrades. FIX: isFalEditModel now detects `/edit` segment on any slash-containing slug (fal-ai/, openai/, black-forest-labs/, anthropic/, google/, any future vendor). Mirrors what stripFalEditSuffix already did correctly. New model namespaces work automatically with zero code changes — the prerequisite for modular multi-vendor model support. Test coverage: fal_edit_detector_namespace_test.go pins behavior across 5 vendor namespaces (15 edit-detection cases + 16 non-edit cases + round-trip with stripFalEditSuffix + resolveFalImageSlug editMode=true passthrough + a source-scan regression guard that fails CI if anyone reintroduces the `hasFalPrefix(m)` fast-path that caused the incident). Full Go test suite green (241s). NO BREAKING CHANGES — fal-ai/ slugs detect identically; legacy `-edit` aliases detect identically; only the silent-downgrade path for non-fal namespaces is fixed. PRIOR RELEASE v1.23.1: Story-format archive thumbnail fix (live incident, critical). 9:16 vertical / TikTok / Reels / Stories ad thumbnails were center-banded by the archive card's 1:1 aspect-ratio + object-fit:cover, hiding the headline + persona/lifestyle layers above and below the product. Result: story ads looked indistinguishable from generic product hero shots in the archive grid. Three-layer fix: (1) archive-scanner.js TALL_FORMAT_RE detects _story / _vertical / _9x16 / _reel / _reels variants and flags item.tallThumb; picker now prefers _square > _portrait > _thumbnail > non-tall > _story as last resort. (2) renderer.js createArchiveCard adds .archive-card-thumb-tall when item.tallThumb is set. (3) style.css .archive-card-thumb-tall { object-fit: contain } letterboxes the tall image so the FULL composition is visible inside the 1:1 card. 5 new archive-scanner tests + 3 new renderer source-scan tests; full 1215 JS test suite green. REGRESSION GUARD comments anchor the fix in all three files. PRIOR RELEASE v1.23.0: Stefan Georgi RMBC parity — pain copy that users feel RIGHT NOW + StefanBrain.com-grade funnel teardown analyzer + canonical 7-frame quiz funnel generator. Anchor: 2026-05-15. THE SYSTEMIC UPGRADE: every creative Merlin produces is now structured against Stefan Georgi's RMBC method — Research, Mechanism, Brief, Copy. Pre-v1.23.0 RMBC was a one-line dropdown reference in merlin-content; now it's a load-bearing schema enforced through five layers of source code. PAINSTATE SCHEMA (iter 1): BrandManifestPersona.PainState{BodyLocation, PresentTenseTrigger, SensoryCue, Mechanism, FailedSolutions[]} — every persona can declare its body-felt pain anchor. validateBrandManifest enforces specificity (body_location ≥2 words — 'lower belly under the ribs', not 'stomach'), present-tense (trigger must read present-continuous — rejects 'she felt tired'), and ≥3 words per failed_solution entry. forbidden_pain_framings extends Rule 12 HARD veto to pain copy. AdBrief.PainState carries the same shape through to render time; runImagePipeline auto-resolves from the matched persona when the brief is empty. CheckBrief emits pain_framing_forbidden_for_brand (Rule 12 parity) + pain_state_missing on matrix-driven briefs whose persona declares PainState but the sampler didn't propagate it. RUBRIC + COPY QUALITY GATE (iter 2): rubric.go gains 5 polish checks — pain_body_localized, pain_present_tense, pain_sensory_anchor, pain_mechanism_named (mandatory when angle=mechanism), pain_failed_solution_validated. format_brief_check.go gains opening_scenario_tense_not_present + conflict_beat_tense_not_present warns (catches authoring past-tense regressions before generation). merlin-content's Copy Quality Gate grows from 7 to 8 experts — the new Stefan Georgi pain-state copywriter weighs 1.5× (parity with the AI-writing detector) and scores: present-continuous tense, named body location, sensory cue ≥1 per 100 words, named mechanism when angle=mechanism, validated failed solution ≥1. FUNNEL TEARDOWN ANALYZER (iter 3): new funnel-teardown action — fetch a URL, score it against the 20-criterion RMBC rubric (5 criteria × 4 sections: LEAD / MECHANISM / PAIN AMPLIFICATION / CLOSE), emit letter grades with leak callouts. Output: results/teardown_<ts>/teardown.{json,md,raw.html}. This is Merlin's StefanBrain.com equivalent — same Stefan Georgi rubric, same section-by-section grading, same 'top 6 leaks ordered by section weight' fix list. The 20 criterion IDs are stable so wisdom aggregates across brands. QUIZ FUNNEL GENERATOR (iter 4): new quiz-funnel-gen action — given the brand's persona + PainState, generate the canonical Stefan Georgi 7-frame quiz funnel (entry → demographic → symptom → failed_solution → mechanism reveal → results → offer with 30/60/90-day segment pricing). Output is a self-contained HTML file (vanilla JS state machine, inline CSS, no CDN dependencies) deployable to any static host. requireApproval-gated per Hard-Won Security Rule 18. Email-capture via configurable POST endpoint; about:blank fallback for safe local previews. All manifest-supplied strings HTML-escaped — no XSS holes from a hostile manifest. TELEMETRY (iter 5): WisdomAdEntry gains 5 new fields parallel to angle — PainBodyLocation, PainSensoryCue, MechanismType (categorical bucket via mechanismTypeFromText: hormonal/neurological/metabolic/musculoskeletal/psychological/other), FailedSolnCount (clamped 0-20), RMBCGrade (A→F when funnel-teardown ran on the LP). wisdom-api/worker.js adds 5 new aggregation buckets (painBodies, painCues, mechanismTypes, failedSolutionDensity, rmbcGrades) — same omit-on-empty pattern as iter-4 persona/LP buckets so legacy ads don't dilute aggregates. The wisdom system now learns which (body location, sensory cue, mechanism category, failed-solution density, RMBC grade) combinations win across brands. SKILLS: merlin-content gets the 8th Copy Quality Gate expert; mcp__merlin__dashboard adds 'funnel-teardown' action; mcp__merlin__content adds 'quiz-funnel-gen' action. TEST COVERAGE: 19 PainState schema tests, 14 rubric + tense-lint tests, 23 funnel-teardown tests, 14 quiz-funnel tests, 2 wisdom-telemetry tests. Full Go suite stays green (241s); full JS suite 71 wisdom-api + 52 mcp-tools + 6 mcp-parity tests stay green. NO BREAKING CHANGES — legacy briefs without PainState generate creatives via existing free-prose path; rubric polish checks pass when PainState is absent (no false-negative gating). BACK-COMPAT FOOTNOTE: from v1.22.4 (persona × LP × Andromeda) and v1.23.0 (Stefan Georgi RMBC), Merlin now provides StefanBrain.com-tier funnel analysis + Stefan Georgi-tier pain copywriting through the SAME existing creative pipeline, with zero new tool surface — the agent simply pulls richer signal from a brand-manifest enriched with PainState. Three fixes shipped together: shopifyAdminFetch retries on 403 with [0, 1500, 3000]ms backoff (covers the propagation race), the stub renderer drops the alarming orange banner (raw status codes never surface to users per Hard-Won Rule 6), <meta http-equiv='refresh' content='10'> closes the race window without user intervention. META-CONNECT PARSE FIX (PR #265): live incident — Meta OAuth completed successfully but the binary printed two JSON blocks back-to-back, the old extractJsonBlock line-trim heuristic concatenated them, JSON.parse failed with 'Unexpected non-whitespace character after JSON at position 73', raw error surfaced in the Connection Failed modal.
